crossover_gate: C0 and C1 must reproduce formal metrics within floating-point tolerance and raw candidate scale/index alignment must be exact
e6_gate: Develop E6 only if crossover and localization diagnostics support classification benefit plus box-geometry degradation plus value of the original regression path
ablation_gate: Run only after stable positive E6 three-seed evidence
validation_search_policy: No iterative variants on the same validation set
